original_five_level_archive_geometry_tra.limitations: Only thickness-direction volume discretization varies on the original fixed polyhedral shell; all sampled boundary tractions and frozen physical inputs are checked. Raw global corner peaks and work identities are independently reconstructed. Equilibrium budgets are recorded from the independently assembled FEM driver, not reassembled here. A thickness tail does not establish CAD/surface/contact convergence, native accuracy, deformable-contact feedback or the full Franka application. All original gates remain.

fresh_full_matrix_corner_quadrature_and_.scope: Reassemble the original five-level thickness FEM fields without repeating their solves.
fresh_full_matrix_corner_quadrature_and_.limitations: Reassembled scikit-fem stiffness, consistent mass, inertia relief and full field reconstruction extend the existing fixed-boundary/traction archive audit; no new linear solve or changed physical problem is introduced. Original36-probe changes and unaveraged global peaks remain unchanged. Quadrature stresses are compared with the complete saved affine corner field. Original force samples are retained rather than replaced by a new load law. This closes a numerical evidence scope gap, not the unresolved physical tensor tail, spatial/contact/geometry/model/feedback acceptance or verified warmed native cost.
